meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长回复压成极简短句,省字又不丢技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果嫌 AI 回话啰嗦,想用更少字数抓到关键信息。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long replies into terse lines that keep the technical points.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if replies feel too wordy and you want the key points in fewer words.

howto.what: Claude 改用极简电报式回答:去掉冠词、填充词、客套话,句子可成片段,技术内容、代码块、错误原文照旧保留。默认 full 级别,整场会话持续生效,直到你说 stop caveman 或 normal mode。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman,或说 “caveman mode”、“talk like caveman” 等口令时接管。遇安全警告、不可逆操作确认等易误读场合会临时切回正常表达,之后恢复。

say.text: 用 caveman ultra 模式回答

say.note: 保留冠词和完整句子,只删填充词
退出压缩模式,恢复正常回答

howto.what_en: Claude replies terse like caveman: no articles, filler or pleasantries, fragments OK; technical content, code blocks, error strings stay exact. Default level full, lasts whole session until you say "stop caveman".
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman or say "caveman mode", "talk like caveman" etc. Drops caveman for security warnings, irreversible-action confirmations and other misread risks, then resumes.

say_en.note: Keeps articles and full sentences, drops filler
